finding.title: Support tickets are kept for 3 years and deleted after one year
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds a ticket store that keeps a closed ticket for 3 years (`Support tickets are kept for 3 years after the ticket is closed.`, S:10) and deletes the same ticket one year after closing (`Closed support tickets are deleted one year after closing.`, S:18). A ticket closed 18 months ago must be present and absent, so the retention test for tickets cannot pass.
